operations.retryable_errors: N/A (initiation is an API call — standard API retry errors apply)
operations.permanent_errors: Retained payload unavailable (retention exceeded), insufficient scope, delivery not found
operations.evidence_behavior: Returns replay_receipt and replayed_event_ids. Each replay attempt recorded with new delivery attempt ID.

operations.operation: delivery retry (manual retry of failed delivery)
operations.repeated_request_result: Retry is idempotent — calling retry on an already-retried delivery does not create duplicate deliveries
operations.retryable_errors: Standard API retry errors: network timeout, rate limit
operations.permanent_errors: 4xx (except 429): insufficient scope, event not found, idempotency conflict
operations.evidence_behavior: Returns retry_receipt with delivery_id and status. Retry re-uses original delivery — does not re-ingest from source.
